params.prompt: Award-winning website hero screen, 16:9, cinematic and premium. Scene: a darkened optician's examination room, deep ink background #0B0F14 with soft falloff. Tiny wordmark 'SAID IN COLOUR' top-left in cool white. Bottom-right: a minimal two-segment control 'ONE: YOU' / 'TWO: EVERYONE' with the first segment filled #0072B2 and white text. Subtle film grain. Moody, precise, luxury menswear meets optics.
